description:
Stop `scripts/cargo-ci.sh` reporting a compiler-wrapper failure as a verdict on repository content.

## Background

Gate run `112ec06a-8d74-4312-9291-9c238c68c31f` ended with `step 'suite-build' failed on repository content`. The real cause was the host's shared sccache daemon: another project's run had left it with a deleted `TMPDIR`, so every compile through it failed with `sccache: Failed to create temp dir`. `scripts/cargo-ci.sh` selects sccache around line 190 and already guards a related sccache case around line 143.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: When the compiler wrapper cannot run, `scripts/cargo-ci.sh` says so by name and exits with the environment status its header defines, so the run records no verdict on repository content.
- [hard] REQ-02: The check extends the existing sccache handling; the script has one mechanism for sccache health.
- [hard] REQ-03: `scripts/cargo-ci-selftest.sh` covers a wrapper that cannot run.
title: cargo-ci reports a broken compiler wrapper as the environment, not repository content
